en.name: Leo V
en.summary: A pope deposed and imprisoned within weeks of his election by a rival priest, Christopher, who then seized the papacy himself.
en.body: Leo V's brief reign ended when the priest Christopher, whom he had reportedly trusted, had him seized and imprisoned in order to claim the papacy himself. Leo apparently died in confinement, another casualty of the violent factional struggles that characterized the Roman church in this period.
